column1: Note 1:Reference measurement channel RC.31 FDD according to Table A.4-1 with one sided dynamic OCNG Pattern OP.1 FDD and two sided dynamic OCNG pattern OP.2 FDD as described in Annex A.5.1.1 and A.5.1.2.Note 2:The minimum requirements shall be fulfilled for at least one of the two SNR(s) and the respective wanted signal input level.Note 3:DC subcarrier puncturing shall be considered.Note 4:To avoid collisions between CQI reports and HARQ-ACK it is necessary to report both on PUSCH instead of PUCCH.
